requirements: R1: The gate starts in the BarrierClosed state with the barrier fully lowered.
R2: When a valid paid parking ticket is inserted while in BarrierClosed, the gate validates the ticket and moves to the BarrierOpening state.
R3: When the barrier reaches the fully raised position while in BarrierOpening, the gate moves to the BarrierOpen state.
R4: When a vehicle passage is detected while in BarrierOpen, the gate moves to the BarrierClosing state.
R5: When the barrier reaches the fully lowered position while in BarrierClosing, the gate returns to BarrierClosed.
R6: When an invalid or expired ticket is inserted while in BarrierClosed, the gate must not open the barrier and must remain in BarrierClosed.
R7: When an authorized manual override command is received while in BarrierClosed, the gate moves to BarrierOpen.
R8: When the override release command is received while in BarrierOpen due to manual override, the gate moves to BarrierClosing.
R9: When a safety sensor fault is detected in any state, the gate moves to the Fault state with the barrier held closed.
R10: When the sensor fault is cleared while in Fault, the gate returns to BarrierClosed.
R11: The gate must not enter BarrierOpen unless either a valid ticket was accepted or a manual override was authorized.
R12: While in BarrierOpen due to a valid ticket, the gate must eventually return to BarrierClosed after vehicle passage is detected.
